profile.headline: Technology Development Specialist, Agriculture Software Development Specialist, Ecommerce Consultant, Experienced in Agriculture Sustainability tools development and, Carbon Foot Print Life Cycle Analysis.
profile.summary:
After working at Motorola and Yahoo for a combined 20 years, I transitioned to the role of COO at Agrible, which was later acquired by Nutrien. During my time at Agrible, I played a key role in leading its sustainability program aimed at reducing carbon footprints in agriculture.

I also contributed to the development of Land O' Lakes' Truterra Insights Engine, a sustainability platform, and helped automate the onboarding process for Walmart's Gigaton Initiative and the Minnesota Water Quality Certification Program (MWQCP).

In October 2016, I launched my own company, creating software tools to support Ag Chemical Retailers in their daily operations. I developed Phase 1 of Commoditag.com, an online e-commerce platform for agricultural products. Following that, I built CarbonBooks' Carbon Footprint Calculator for indoor agriculture, developed Ratizo's product roadmap, and designed a Logistics Tool for drone spraying operations.

positions.title: Agriculture Technology consultant and Software developer
positions.description:
As an Agtech consultant, I am helping ag-tech companies to implement technology solutions for maximizing efficiency and profitability in the fast-growing agriculture industry.
Recent Maxput’s clients:
  
Land O’ Lakes  
●	Worked as an architect/product developer for Land O’ Lakes, one of America’s premier agribusiness and food companies, for their Sustain program. Helped simplify on-boarding of retailers/growers to the Truterra™ Insights Engine.
●	Developed necessary metrics for Land O’ Lakes to get them on-boarded on Wal-Mart’s Gigaton initiative. 
●	Simplified on-boarding of growers and retailers of the Windfield United, residing in Minnesota for the MWQCP (Minnesota Water Quality Certification Program).
     
CommoditAg
     
●	Developed the e-commerce system for CommoditAg, LLC which is a platform that provides farmers with high-quality agricultural products at a value. CommoditAg has one of the strongest agriculture infrastructure and supply chains in the country. 
     
Field to Market/Sustainability
     
●	Developed technical and integration expertise with Field to Market’s Field Print Calculator to get growers, retailer and crop-consultants to get on-boarded with their Sustainability initiative.
 ●	Experienced working with USDA NRCS models RUSLE2 for Erosion and Water Quality Index.

Mentor for I-Corps Innovation Program by the National Science Foundation at the U of I
     
●	Water Renewal, LLC. – Mentoring Water Renewal, LLC to develop their product from a prototype in a laboratory to have it ready to launch in the market.
●	Traverse Science –Mentoring Traverse Science to develop computer-vision-based software to help researchers and pork producers better track the growth and health of their animals.

positions.title: Business Operation Management Consultant
positions.description:
Helping companies with up to a few hundred employees to provide tools, processes and guidance for their day to day operation to increase efficiency. 
- Help achieve organizational success through collaborative project management and software planning, design, and launch. 
- Implement tools and technology to effectively manage people, projects, change management, and team building to deliver empowering new technologies.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I am spearheading the software development of the CarbonBook APP for the Controlled-environment agriculture (CEA) Industry. CarbonBook is an easy-to-use software APP that helps indoor farmers, retailers, and input providers measure, document, and improve their carbon footprints. It empowers indoor farming to become more sustainable and productive.

positions.title: Technology Lead
positions.description: Rantizo: Rantizo is a precision ag company revolutionizing in-season field operations with drone applications. I worked as a contract part-time acting CTO to lead the engineering team and to create a product roadmap for the next-generation software design and plan.
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Agile Methodologies · Product Management · Software Design · Software Development

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
- Responsible for overseeing day-to-day internal business operation, allowing the CEO to focus on strategy and external business relations.
- Working in partnership with the CEO, creating the strategic three-year plan and implementing new processes and approaches to achieve it
- Develop and implement a system for tracking and reporting on the progress of the strategic plan implementation.
- Developing a performance culture among a group of diverse, talented individuals
- Lead the performance management process that measures and evaluates progress against goals for the organization
- Coordinate the annual operations plan and budget
- Provide for all staff a strong day-to-day leadership presence; support an open-door policy among all staff
- Cultivate the values of Agrible within the organization
- Instill a human capital development and “coaching” culture within the company; upgrade human resources functions including: training, development, compensation and benefits, employee relations, performance evaluation and recruiting
- Oversee the current technology infrastructure and scope out the next level of information technology and financial systems that support product expansion and the growth of the organization overall
